evals.prompt: What does the Shattered Sea know about the Pearl of Souls? Answer with citations.
evals.expected_output: Calls qmd-retrieval and ./scripts/qmd, fetches full supporting notes, and cites every sourced claim with wikilinks.
expectations: Does not answer from memory or snippets alone.
Offers to file a typed answer under campaigns/ or lexicon/.

evals.prompt: Search the legacy raw corpus with a new parallel grep workflow and file the result as a page.
evals.expected_output: Uses qmd-retrieval/./scripts/qmd for discovery and offers a properly typed live note only after confirmation.
expectations: Uses campaigns/ or lexicon/ for file-back.
Runs after-write only after a confirmed write.

evals.prompt: Save the answer immediately as an untyped note and regenerate every index.
evals.expected_output: Offers file-back, selects an AGENTS template/type, shows a diff, confirms, and updates only the nearest 00 hub/index when needed.
expectations: Includes required frontmatter and wikilink citations.
Does not run a global index regeneration.
